\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{semilogyaxis}[
    width=9cm,
    height=6cm,
    log basis y=2,
    xmin=0,
    xmax=6,
    ymin=1,
    ymax=64,
    grid=major,
    xlabel={Time $t$ (s)},
    ylabel={Energy $E$ (J)}
  ]
    \addplot[orange,very thick,mark=triangle*] coordinates {
      (0,1) (1,2) (2,4) (3,8) (4,16) (5,32) (6,64)
    };
  \end{semilogyaxis}
\end{tikzpicture}
